message:
fix(dlss): make scene-copy promotion and restore slot-safe

Do not Flush after guest draw descriptors and offsets are prepared.
Preflight target/depth/extent transitions before borrowing attachments,
fail closed on restore failure, retain promotion across ordinary Flush,
and discard the mapping only after resize drains its GPU users.
Keep the host layout tracker synchronized and allow one promotion per frame.

Add 29 CPU boundary checks. The Unknown color guard remains unchanged;
this is not in-game SR or Gate 3 acceptance.
